name: Lava Keep Siege
description: Breach the gates of Lava Keep and explore the fortress once.

narrative.accept: Captain Vaelen commands, "The Lava Keep is the stronghold of the Fire Monarch. We must lay siege and storm the gates!"
narrative.complete: "A decisive victory! The keep has fallen, but the source of the flame remains."
narrative.hint: Travel to Lava Keep and explore it.
